question: Can the LITERATURE support a question where the registry's coded fields cannot?
why: 22 topics were headed for escalation because no coded intervention or condition matched what the topic is named for. The literature limb is proven on this corpus -- 31 of 53 and 7 of 11 -- so the registry saying nothing useful is not the same as there being nothing.

what_this_enumerated_over.route_run: ClinicalTrials.gov referencesModule for every included trial, every type
what_this_enumerated_over.what_was_NOT_done: THE QUESTIONS WERE NOT DERIVED. This establishes only that a literature route EXISTS for each topic. Turning a publication into a question requires reading it, and that is the next unit of work.
